source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
This must be a comprehensive summary of tests done.
3. The ad spec name must be listed along with the test conditions used.
4. If multiple test conditions exist for the failure, include them all.
5. Include any unique factors such as a unique lot or other unique information.
6. Include the test results.  This is especially important when a significant failure happening just outside the specification.
7. Include who ran the test
8. Describe why this failure is a significant failure.
9. Enter the case number.
10. Start your writeup by summarizing what was done.  Do this the very first time you talk to anyone.  Why?  Because it's harder to do it later and your summary will be wrong if you do not create it fresh in your mind during a conversation.
11. Get the general details for any piece you are responsible for.
12. Talk to
